title: Cancel can enable a previously disabled global schedule
reproduction: Disable a configured daily schedule; choose Daily or Weekly in global editor; cancel the time or day picker
expected: Cancel leaves enabled flag and previous schedule unchanged
observed: editGlobalSchedule writes enabled=true before opening either cancelable picker
fix: Commit enabled flag only in final time-confirmation callback
test_evidence: Daily/weekly cancellation cases passed on API34; daily baseline assertion demonstrated disabled old schedule became enabled. Confirmation writes through existing complete schedule setter.

title: No visible protection toggle or VPN reauthorization path
reproduction: Stop VPN or revoke consent after setup then open Home
expected: Explicit resume or pause with a new consent request when needed
observed: Old Home had no caller for toggleAdBlocking and referred to a removed FAB
fix: Inline switch with explicit enable/disable and activity-result consent handling
test_evidence: Initial connected regression failed on baseline then passed; real API34 denial/retry/rotation/grant starts tun0. Independent review identified HOME-PATCH001/002/003 timing gaps; follow-up implementation and validation pending, not a merge-ready whole-control claim.

title: Same-frame taps can queue duplicate operations
reproduction: Hold apply in the executor then tap twice and recreate Home
expected: One queued operation and a correctly disabled then enabled control
observed: Old pending state was posted only after executor dispatch so callers could pass the guard twice
fix: Atomic claim before dispatch and main-thread completion notification
test_evidence: repeatedTapsQueueOneOperationAndRecreatedViewUnlocks passed with applyCount=1; pre-fix race was source-confirmed rather than executed

title: Scheduled progress can remain visible after completion
reproduction: Replay scheduled running then terminal after subscription observer settles; repeat with overlapping subscription work and both delivery orders
expected: Terminal work clears its shared progress unless another task remains active
observed: Source confirms scheduled terminal branch never cleared the shared views and snackbar field did not represent subscription activity
fix: Retain separate WorkInfo snapshots and render shared views through one stable-priority renderer; hand off to remaining work; scope monotonic guards to ID attempt generation and total
test_evidence: API34 HomeWorkProgressRegressionInstrumentedTest6 passed in97-case integration; real observer replay with work snapshots. Full suite and live worker overlap remain broader gates.

title: Protection active can be shown with no blocking rules after onboarding failure
reproduction: Replay applied VPN true with zero or unknown active stats; change current snapshot during detached-counter import and recreate
expected: Vpn enablement and loaded blocking rules are distinguished without changing the switch applied state
observed: Original status depended only on applied Boolean; counter observation pauses during import
fix: Keep an independent lifecycle observer on the method-specific active blocking-count snapshot; show enabled with no rules or checking rules until positive; preserve actual-state switch logic; allow warning wrapping
test_evidence: API34 HomeProtectionStatusRegressionInstrumentedTest5 and HomeLaunchNavigationStateInstrumentedTest13 passed with explicit positive blocking fixture; no rules/unknown stats and actual applied switch states verified. Final live APK smoke pending.

title: Retired default URLhaus feed prevents first blocking-rules import
reproduction: Fresh onboarding downloads four defaults including retired URLhaus hostfile
expected: First-run defaults resolve without account-specific credentials
observed: URLhaus HTTP410 causes the source transaction to retain zero blocked rows despite three successful downloads
fix: Removed retired endpoint from catalog and presets; existing user sources remain unchanged
test_evidence: Fresh API34 setup with normal VPN consent: three HTTP200 defaults, 91774 accepted source rows, zero failed; Home81.7k blocked. Intermediate debug APK hash and screenshots/logs in validation.md. Existing persisted user sources intentionally unchanged.

title: Asynchronous initial values can overwrite unsaved fields after recreation
reproduction: Proposed replay: edit fields then recreate while holding initial DAO load until after view state restoration
expected: Unsaved name URL and format survive rotation
observed: Every edit-mode onCreate reloads and unconditionally applies database values without distinguishing restored form state
fix: Save an initialized form draft across recreation; restore all fields before listeners; load entity metadata without overwriting a restored or newer draft; ignore destroyed-owner callbacks and suppress picker side effects during state restoration. Saving-operation lifecycle is a separate pending case.
test_evidence: SourceEditAddEditInstrumentedTest: all 12 cases passed in full batch-three, including all four draft recreation cases. Save/delete lifecycle remains separate AUD-EDIT-002.

title: Dangling symlinks are omitted from file inventory
reproduction: Create a nonignored symlink whose target is absent and refresh inventory
expected: Track and hash the link itself even when its target is absent
observed: Path.exists false caused the file to be skipped before fingerprint could use readlink
fix: Keep symlinks regardless of target existence; new inventory regression
test_evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p test_*.py: 6 tests passed, including dangling symlink inventory and reviewed-file hash drift.

title: Save and delete completion remain owned by a destroyed editor
reproduction: Proposed replay: hold diskIO after Apply or confirmed Delete; recreate editor; release mutation; inspect new editor and duplicate Apply behavior.
expected: Retain in-flight state and deliver success/failure to the current editor exactly once.
observed: saving is an Activity field. The old task commits data but postMutationResult returns for the destroyed Activity; new Activity has saving=false and receives no terminal event.
fix: Activity-scoped SourceEditViewModel owns pending, success and retryable failure state; application-only worker callbacks; current Activity observes completion, blocks duplicate saves/deletes and retains drafts.
test_evidence: API34 SourceEditAddEditInstrumentedTest17 passed, including five new held mutation/recreation/error retry cases; process death durability not claimed.

title: Disabled Material buttons ignore initial saved filter type
reproduction: Open an existing Allow source with the initial editor draft patch; inspect format then rename it. Also inspect File type immediately on first load.
expected: Initial loaded format and source type match database values; label-only edits preserve imported rules and format.
observed: Initial draft patch disables Material buttons then assigns checked states before re-enabling. Material 1.12.0 ignores setChecked while disabled, potentially showing Allow as Block.
fix: Enable controls before assigning initial database values while change listeners remain unbound; preserve initialized draft after recreation.
test_evidence: Both initial Allow/File state assertions failed before enabling controls prior to initial assignment; all 12 SourceEditAddEditInstrumentedTest cases passed afterward in full batch-three.

title: Pending Apply message disappears during a same-frame transition
reproduction: Show a pending selection then briefly return to the applied selection and back in the same main-thread callback; also finish a targeted update while another source remains pending.
expected: Pending selections retain a visible Apply action after animations settle.
observed: Material Snackbar still reports shown or queued while dismissal is underway; reusing that callback drops the next request although SourceApplyState remains pending.
fix: Explicitly dismissed pending snackbar is replaced with a fresh instance/callback; subsequent pending selections cannot reuse a dismissing callback.
test_evidence: API34 focused pass: SourceApplyFeedbackInstrumentedTest 2; SourcesApplyStateRegressionTest 9; real DownloadProvider 1. Same-frame reversal failed before fix. First fixture revisions timed out in idle cleanup; corrected cleanup preserves UI/state assertions.

title: Writer flush failure skips output closure
reproduction: Proposed nonprivileged throwing OutputStream fixture: buffer hosts bytes then fail first flush during close
expected: Owned output closes even on flush failure; original error retained
observed: close invokes flushBuffer before output.close with no finally
fix: Always close with suppressed-exception-safe resource ownership
test_evidence: Full source read only; fixture not run; privileged runtime excluded

title: Hosts editor exposes file URI and misses failed-launch remount cleanup
reproduction: Proposed modern Android external hosts editor launch; no privileged run performed
expected: Supported content URI or controlled editor; failed launch restores prior mount mode
observed: file URI ACTION_VIEW under target34; narrow catches; remount cleanup only in result callback
fix: Use bounded safe sharing/editing path and failure-safe cleanup; no broad filesystem exposure
test_evidence: Source-confirmed launch/cleanup trace only; root runtime outside user scope
